name: KAUST Fellowship (Saudi Arabia)
funding: Most admitted KAUST students get full tuition, a stipend of $20,000 a year for a master's or $25,000–30,000 for a PhD, campus housing, health insurance and relocation costs.
deadline: Fall 2027, round 2: Sep 28, 2026 – Jan 3, 2027 (KAUST calls these dates tentative)
